say:1:1621222001:1.text: Anything I can help you with, mage friends?
say:1:1621222001:1.source_cn: 有什么可以帮到你们的吗？魔法师朋友。

say:2:1621222002:1.text: Mr. Hamell, the truth is... we're hoping to join the Animal Protection Association.
say:2:1621222002:1.source_cn: 哈梅尔先生，其实我们这次来……是想试着加入动物保护协会。

say:3:1621222003:1.text: Ha! Is that your idea of a joke? Two top students from the Lyceum wanting to throw in with a bunch of woodland drifters?
say:3:1621222003:1.source_cn: 哈，这是你们的幽默方式吗？两个来自莱希拉姆的学院高徒，...

say:5:1621222004:1.text: Hmm... I have to admit, this is all rather sudden.
say:5:1621222004:1.source_cn: 唔……我实在有些难以理解，这一切来得太突然了。

choice_prompt:6:1621222004.text: Hmm... I have to admit, this is all rather sudden.
choice_prompt:6:1621222004.source_cn: 唔……我实在有些难以理解，这一切来得太突然了。

say:7:1621222005:1.text: Yes, Mr. Hamell. We're students, just looking for something to help us get by.
say:7:1621222005:1.source_cn: 是的，哈梅尔先生，我们都是学生，想找些差事贴补一下生活。
say:7:1621222005:1.male: Yes, Mr. Hamell. We're students, just looking for something to help us get by.
say:7:1621222005:1.female: Yes, Mr. Hamell. We're students, just looking for something to help us get by.

say:8:1621222006:1.text: Strange request. Most folks don't come here looking for odd jobs.
say:8:1621222006:1.source_cn: 差事？这倒是少见的请求。

say:9:1621222007:1.text: We do take on extra hands now and then... but don't expect a hefty reward.
say:9:1621222007:1.source_cn: 协会确实偶尔会招些帮手，只不过嘛……我们可给不了什么丰...

say:10:1621222008:1.text: Actually... there's almost no reward at all. I doubt you're the type to work for free.
say:10:1621222008:1.source_cn: 或者说……报酬几乎等于没有，我觉得你们不能接受这种程度...

say:11:1621222013:1.text: But Mr. Hamell... you said anyone could join. That it's open to all.
say:11:1621222013:1.source_cn: 可是哈梅尔先生……你说过协会是民间组织，任何人都有机会。

say:12:1621222014:1.text: And it is. I'm not turning you away. Just... I've seen too many folks show up with bright eyes and walk away disappointed.
say:12:1621222014:1.source_cn: 当然可以，魔法师朋友。我不是在关门，只是习惯了人们转身...

say:13:1621222015:1.text: You don't strike me as the kind who'd lose sleep over a squirrel, or trade your free time for backbreaking work.
say:13:1621222015:1.source_cn: 你们看起来不像会为几只松鼠奔波劳碌的人，也不像会将时间...

say:14:1621222016:1.text: Maybe not. But you said it yourself, everyone's "guiding technique" is different. Who's to say ours won't work on the ones yours can't reach?
say:14:1621222016:1.source_cn: 也许我们不像，但你不是说，引导技艺因人而异吗？说不定，...

say:15:1621222017:1.text: Guiding animals is only the first step. What comes after are wounds to treat and mouths to feed. It's a tedious way to spend your days.
say:15:1621222017:1.source_cn: 引导技艺只是让我们接触到动物，真正的救助其实是大同小异...

choice_prompt:16:1621222017.text: Guiding animals is only the first step. What comes after are wounds to treat and mouths to feed. It's a tedious way to spend your days.
choice_prompt:16:1621222017.source_cn: 引导技艺只是让我们接触到动物，真正的救助其实是大同小异，并且很枯燥的。

say:17:1621222018:1.text: Good... Too many think this is a stroll through pretty woods. But keep walking, and you'll find storm and stillness both.
say:17:1621222018:1.source_cn: 呵……那就好。太多人将这条路看作一场短途旅行，真正走下...

say:18:1621222019:1.text: If you're ready to get your cloak muddy and wear holes in your boots, then by all means, prove me wrong.
say:18:1621222019:1.source_cn: 若你们已做好披风沾泥、鞋底磨破的准备——那就来试试吧。

say:19:1621222022:1.text: I wouldn't call it tedious. There's a lot to learn here. And... to be honest, I'm pretty curious about your flute work, Mr. Hamell.
say:19:1621222022:1.source_cn: 我也不觉得这件事有多枯燥，还能学到不少东西。其实……我...

say:20:1621222023:1.text: Oh? Then you'd better think it through. That sort of skill isn't exactly... celebrated.
say:20:1621222023:1.source_cn: 哦？那你可得想清楚。那种技艺可不是什么人人称道的好本事。

say:21:1621222024:1.text: Out in the world, flute players show up more in ghost stories than in legends. We're associated with haunting tunes that lead children into the forest, or curses that draw rats into villages...
say:21:1621222024:1.source_cn: 在民间，吹笛人的传说，可大多带着点阴影。不是引孩子入林...

say:22:1621222025:1.text: So you're one of those "dangerous types"?
say:22:1621222025:1.source_cn: 那你不就是传说里的“危险分子”？

say:23:1621222026:1.text: Ha! At worst, I'm a strange man who knows a few tunes.
say:23:1621222026:1.source_cn: 哈，我最多算个懂些音律的怪人吧。

say:24:1621222027:1.text: But in all seriousness, if you really want in, there's a trial first.
say:24:1621222027:1.source_cn: 但说正经的——如果你们真的想加入协会，那得先通过试用期。

say:25:1621222028:1.text: Let's see... Deep in the forest, there have been <style="highlight">magical traps</style> showing up. Strange <style="highlight">toxic fruits</style>, too. And they're starting to hurt the animals.
say:25:1621222028:1.source_cn: 让我想想……森林深处那些<style=highligh...

say:26:1621222029:1.text: Your first test is to <style="highlight">clear them out</style>. These herbs will neutralize most of the toxins. Use them if you need to.

choice:16:0:1.text: We're not here because it's easy.
choice:16:0:1.male: We're not here because it's easy.
choice:16:0:1.female: We're not here because it's easy.

say:29:1621222020:1.text: If you truly hear poetry in rustling leaves, and see romance in claws and wings... then who am I to argue?
say:29:1621222020:1.source_cn: 若你们真能在枝叶间听出诗意，在兽蹄与羽鸣中看见温柔，那...

say:30:1621222021:1.text: The forest remembers those who tread it with care. I'll keep the association's door open for you.
say:30:1621222021:1.source_cn: 森林会记得你们的脚步，我也愿意暂借协会的门，为你们敞一...

choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 拯救自然本身就很浪漫

choice:6:0:1.text: We've been short on money lately.
choice:6:0:1.male: We've been short on money lately.
choice:6:0:1.female: We've been short on money lately.

say:31:1621222009:1.text: The wind isn't always kind. It can blow you into a storm, or strand you in a swamp.
say:31:1621222009:1.source_cn: 风的指引不总是温柔的——它可能将你们送进雨林的雷暴，也...

say:32:1621222010:1.text: So you're ready for this? No glory, no reward. Just muddy paths, sore feet, and the silent eyes of creatures who trust you without words.
say:32:1621222010:1.source_cn: 你们真打算走这条路？没有奖赏，没有荣耀，只有泥泞的山径...

choice:6:1:2.text: We're here because the wind led us.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我们遵循风的指引来到于此
choice:6:1:2.male: We're here because the wind led us.
choice:6:1:2.female: We're here because the wind led us.

say:33:1621222011:1.text: You know, that actually moved me a little. Not many people care about the voiceless anymore.
say:33:1621222011:1.source_cn: 你这句话，让我有些动容。如今愿意为这些沉默的生灵停步的...

say:34:1621222012:1.text: But if your heart is in the right place, the door is always open. Joining us isn't just signing a few papers, though. It's tying a thread between you and the forest. You'll leave part of yourself here, whether you mean to or not.
say:34:1621222012:1.source_cn: 不过只要你们愿意的话，随时都可以帮助动物，加入协会，就...

choice:6:2:3.text: We want to help the animals.
choice:6:2:3.male: We want to help the animals.
choice:6:2:3.female: We want to help the animals.
